evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs npm ci / npm test / npm run build in site/ (scripts exist in site/package.json) on pull_request (opened/synchronize/reopened/edited) and push to main; top-level permissions contents: read; all actions pinned to full SHAs with version comments; no pull_request_target; PR title passed via env, not interpolated; only github.token used (release.yml GH_TOKEN). pages.yml triggers on push to main + workflow_dispatch, build job contents: read, deploy job pages: write/id-token: write; release.yml on v*.*.* tags with job-level contents: write. Minor gap: pages.yml workflow_dispatch has no `if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` guard, so a manual run from another branch is not blocked by the workflow itself. Nothing was run or pushed.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch 617-770) covers layout, Node 22 via .nvmrc, `npm ci`, `npm run dev`, `npm test` (+ `npm test -- src/lib/units.test.ts`, file exists), `npm run build`, `npm run preview`, prepare-data/index/fieldsets/sample-bullets (all in site/package.json), PAGES_BASE (read in site/vite.config.ts:11), data contribution steps with file paths and sources, issue forms (exist in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE), and MIT license + THIRD-PARTY.md.
evidence.s1_release: CONTRIBUTING.md: version only in site/package.json (0.1.0), SemVer table mapping Conventional Commit types to bumps, step-by-step release (changelog, npm version --no-git-tag-version, release-notes.sh preview, chore(release) commit, tag push); release.yml enforces tag==package.json version, tag on main, changelog section present. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 format with Unreleased section. Dependabot for npm (/site, grouped toolchain) and github-actions. Conventional Commits stated with CI title regex; step-1 commits (e1d1792..ccb8c33) follow it.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route #/compare/<a>/<b> parsed in router.ts:34-42 with href.compare; App.svelte loads Compare.svelte. SVG role=img, aria-label t('compare.profiles') = 'Profiles of {a} and {b}' with record names; each outline one <path> from fullSectionPath of caseOuterProfile; one viewport built from both profiles (compare.ts overlay). Table <caption> 'Dimensions (mm|in)', headers Symbol / A name / B name / Difference, symbols via FIELD_LABELS, cartridge part only, Tol and FIELD_UNITS fields excluded. Metric via formatValue, imperial via displayNumber(...,'in'). Cartridge.svelte adds Label 'Compare with' bound to NativeSelect id (id spreads to <select>) listing other entries by name and a submit button 'Compare'. German strings added (typed Record<keyof typeof en>). All met.
evidence.s2_correctness: Head faces aligned: viewportFor([a,b]) shares zMin=0, landscape xy maps z to x so both start at same x; one mm scale per viewBox. Difference B−A via displayNumber (toPrecision(12)) removes float noise without rounding published digits. Shotshells return null profile and show a note. Minor: Compare.svelte:24 computes Promise.all([load(a), load(b)]) even when a key is unknown, causing an unhandled rejection while the 'unknown' branch renders; dimensionsOf keeps only the first value if one symbol occurs in two groups, with no indication.
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, formatValue, PX_PER_MM), site units.ts displayNumber, units.svelte unitSystem, PageHeader, ScaleRuler, Label, NativeSelect, ShadcnButton. Logic in site/src/lib/compare.ts beside other lib modules; route file, i18n keys, metadata and nav updated in the existing patterns; @layer legacy + :global([data-ui]) CSS as in other routes. Touches only what is needed.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts tests symbols (e min, no eMin), exclusion of tolerances/non-mm/angles, published values, intersection logic, nulls/strings/repeating groups, metric/imperial text and differences, overlay being one closed path, common head line and axis, one mm scale, shotshell null; router.test.ts covers parse/href round trips and malformed compare URLs. Uses Vitest and repo fixtures (lib/testing/fixtures CARTRIDGES). No test of the Compare page or the detail-page select (the repo has no component tests).
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: dimensionRows now unions both maps, merging B-only symbols after their predecessor, a/b typed number|null; lengthText/differenceText return '' for null (compare.ts step3 109-125); tests assert delta L (A only) and R3 (B only) on the real records, which do contain those fields. lede/noDimensions strings updated in en and de to match. Style: no code change in step 3; step 2's CSS already right-aligns th.num and td.num:not(:first-child) (Compare.svelte:178-179) for the two cartridge columns and Difference, so the requested state holds, but the agent's commit does not mention this point.
evidence.cross_step: CONTRIBUTING says PRs leave CHANGELOG.md and the version alone (the maintainer writes them at release); steps 2 and 3 do exactly that. Commits 5a01619 feat(site) and 1698f84 fix(site) follow Conventional Commits, but 1698f84's subject is 73 characters, over the stated 72-character limit. Changes are typed (de typed against en) and tests are updated, so npm test / svelte-check should pass (not run).

unmet_requirements: Step 3 point 2 (right alignment) got no explicit change or acknowledgement; it is satisfied only by CSS already present from step 2
Step 3 commit subject exceeds the 72-character limit in CONTRIBUTING.md
strengths: Thorough, consistent step 1 setup: SHA-pinned least-privilege workflows, a release workflow that checks the tag, version, changelog and main against each other, and an accurate README in which every command exists
Compare view meets every step 2 requirement while reusing caseOuterProfile, viewportFor/fullSectionPath, FIELD_LABELS/orderedFields, formatValue and displayNumber instead of duplicating them
Step 3 bug fix is correct, keeps a sensible row order, and is covered by tests against the real 308 Win./300 Win. Mag. records
issues: Step 3 alignment point received no change or note; it relies on pre-existing step 2 CSS, so the response to the reviewer is not explicit
Compare.svelte starts loading both records even when a key is unknown, causing an unhandled promise rejection; a symbol published in two groups silently keeps only the first value
Step 3 commit subject is 73 characters, over the stated 72-character limit; pages.yml workflow_dispatch has no main-branch guard
review.verdict: The work is well-structured and meets nearly all requirements: step 1's CI, release and docs setup is strong, the compare feature reuses the existing libraries correctly, and the step 3 bug fix is sound and tested. Only minor issues remain: no explicit handling of the alignment point, a stray promise rejection, and a commit subject one character too long.
